content: In this subsection, we aim to better understand DAS by analyzing sentiment-related CNN filters. To do that, 1) we first select a list of the most related CNN filters for predicting each sentiment label (positive, negative neutral). Those filters can be identified according to the learned weights INLINEFORM0 of the output layer INLINEFORM1 . Higher weight indicates stronger relatedness. 2) Recall that in our implementation, each CNN filter has a window size of 3 with Relu activation. We can thus represent each selected filter as a ranked list of trigrams with highest activation values.
